about_the_game:
You are a soldier sent into a radioactive storm to try and clean up the remnants of a nuclear catastrophe.
Play solo or with up to 5 friends, exploring a dystopian urban environment filled with unnatural horrors. Work together using proximity chat to survive and gear up. Fly deeper into the unknown, and uncover the mystery of what broke the world.

SCAVENGE IN ABANDONED CITIES

Drop pod down from your airborne base into abandoned cities, scavenge for loot, and use the Skyhook to escape. Manage the space in your inventory to make the most of your expedition.

If you stay too long you’ll be consumed by the storm, or by one of the many creatures that await you.

SURVIVE ANOMALIES AND MONSTERS

Radiation is spreading: Find supernatural anomalies that distort the space around them, and extract the dangerous artifacts found within. 

Bug-like Monsters have mutated in the fallout, formed from the flesh of corpses. Avoid becoming prey while collecting the resources you need to fight back.

ARM YOURSELF WITH NEW GEAR

The flesh is weak: Replace deteriorating or eaten arms and legs with superior robotic limbs that can improve your stats and grant new abilities. Find or buy guns and grenades to defend yourself.

You'll need all the equipment you can find to survive deeper in the storm.

CORE FEATURES

  • Private Lobbies let you play solo or invite up to 5 friends.

  • Laugh at those friends as they scream through Proximity Chat.

  • Procedurally generated dungeons in a cold war inspired urban environment.

  • Organise space in a grid-based inventory to fit all of your loot.

  • Limbs can be lost on missions: replace them with new prosthetics that grant special abilities.

  • Purchase guns, explosives, and tools to defend yourself from a wide array of monsters.

  • Gear progression through artifact passives, limb stats, and inventory upgrades.

  • Build a robotic companion to take control of in the event of your inevitable death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700 3.60GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A co-op survival horror game set in a supernatural nuclear apocalypse. Drop into abandoned cities to extract radioactive material while being hunted by the bug-like abominations it created. Rebuild your decaying body with prosthetics limbs, arm yourself, and radio your friends for help.
